items.title: Why Ulta (ULTA) Stock Is Up Today
items.summary: Shares of beauty, cosmetics, and personal care retailer Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ:ULTA) jumped 5.5% in the afternoon session after the company appointed specialty retail executive Brieane Olson to its board of directors. items.title: Ulta Beauty (ULTA) Adds Exclusive Brand Launch And 250 Store Rollout
items.summary: Ulta Beauty (NasdaqGS:ULTA) is partnering with hair wellness brand Nutrire for an exclusive retail launch on Ulta.com, followed by a rollout to 250 stores across the US. Nutrire joins Ulta Beauty's Sparked program, which focuses on growth brands curated for early stage discovery. Skincare brand Dr. Reju-All is making its nationwide retail debut at Ulta Beauty, with products available in stores across the US and online.
